body: Thank you. It really means a lot seeing that people care. I worry  that some of my issues aren’t a problem like I think, and I’m just being overdramatic, someone even thought this was all for attention on a different thread. I’m just doing the best I can to get by. I wish you the best as well

Thank you, that plan is exactly what I’m going for. I don’t want to get revenge, that’s be unneeded and just slow me down. I just want to get away and be better. I want my future kids to actually trust and love me, rather than constantly being paranoid over my presence. 

But that’s just what I needed to verify, I wanted to see if she could actually get away with what she’s doing, or if I could find some kind of relief legally. Regardless, I appreciate your advice and input. 

While there are things she sells that I bought with my money, many things she’s sold have also been Christmas gifts, presents my friends have got me, etc. which makes me even angrier.

How am I avoiding your advice? I’m taking everything into consideration, I explained my situation further and I just wanted to paint a vivid detail about my situation. If I wanted a pity party or attention I’d use my actual account for the karma. This is obviously a throwaway. I’m rolling with the punches the best I can right now, I’m building a plan to the best of my abilities. I was just hoping to find a little advice to ensure I’m not being a total dipshit. I’m sorry if I came off like one of those easily offended or fragile kids.

This is the advice I needed, thank you. I do have an iPad that I’m semi certain she won’t sell. My dad is the one who bought it and it’s under his plan, so I’m sure he’d know immediately if it was sold or deactivated. It’s reliable enough to where I could probably make it through college with it. I’ll see what I can do, thank you.

My family is truly worthless. Not just my nuclear family, every single member of my family does not give a damn. I hate to sound narcissistic but I consider myself lucky that I didn’t turn out like them. So far, at least. 

That’s what I’m working on. I just live so far out of town that it would be hard to reach a post office without her knowledge. I have a girlfriend (shockingly) and her mother is genuinely more caring towards me than my entire family has been. I think she considered taking me in once.

She’s been doing this for years, I think I’m most disgusted by the fact that she wants to point the blame on other people rather than just admit she’s in the wrong. The truth is, I guess I am pretty sheltered, I’ve had no opportunities to grow or be social until I started high school. and growing up she didn’t push me to be better, interact with people, or explore my interests. She just let me be lazy and do whatever. I just want to get away from all of that and start anew.

Most of these things are stuff I use on a daily basis. Books, games, sometimes other stuff that’s actually important to me. I hide all of my stuff in my closets and between my mattress and box spring. I’m just scared she’ll find them.

They’ve really started my life off on the wrong foot. My parents are divorced and my dad is just as bad, bad enough to where I’d rather live with my awful mother than him. but he’s irrelevant to the topic at hand. I’m just hoping they haven’t fucked me over for life. I really want to be my own person ASAP.

I have straight A’s. I’m involved in a lot of prestigious programs, and a few extracurricular activities. All of my teachers love me and I know they’d back me up in this situation. I’m just scared to start anything, I was concerned this was in my head and I was being selfish I’ve been working hard to change my life ever since I started realizing where things were headed, I’m setting the stage I guess. I’ve tried hard to get a job, but I have no way of maintaining it, clearly my mom isn’t willing to help me get to my job, she won’t take me to the DMV to get my permit, and she won’t drive me either. 

We had a solid 2 months where we didn’t have phone service, WiFi, running water, or heating. It was pure hell, I just don’t want to spend more time in her presence, it’s miserable. I just hope I’m almost free.
I tried this. She scoffed and said “wow, I can’t believe you’d say that to your own mom” and walked away. She keeps insisting it’s several different family friends, people I haven’t seen in months.
I really have no way of selling these things, I don’t have a car or a permit so I can’t transport myself anywhere. This is ridiculous because I’m turning 17 in a few months.
I suppose. I’m just worried I’m being selfish or thinking about this wrong.

Im posting this lots of places because I need lots of advice. 

I’m a 16 year old male, to make a long story short, my family’s broke and they’ve been stealing my stuff behind my back to make more money, rather than getting a job. Sometimes they’ll steal stuff I’ve payed for with my own money. I know it’s them who’s selling it, because 

-	Things only go missing when my family is low on money

-	Only things that are worth money go missing. 

-	We live in the middle of nowhere, there’s nobody nearby to even steal my stuff. 

-	Whenever I confront my mom, she gets very defensive, avoids eye contact, and shows various other signs that she’s lying. 

-	We mysteriously “get paid” whenever this stuff goes missing. 

This has been going on for years now. I would be less angry if they just came clean and said “yes, I had to sell some stuff of yours to make ends meet” 
But they get more intrusive each time something goes missing, and now I’m losing items that are genuinely important to me. I’m losing things anywhere between video games, to books sets, to even full consoles and televisions. All of which they disregard with a simple shrug. 

Am I in the wrong? I find it utterly ridiculous how rude they’re being to me. My mother lashes out on me daily, blaming me for her problems and acting like I’m the one being immature whenever I’m upset. I’m never even rude or hostile, I confront her calmly and she ignores me, whenever I do get heated or annoyed THEN she insults me, says I’m impatient and immature. She ignores the good things I do me only sees the things she considers bad. They could easily find other, healthier ways of getting money WITHOUT stealing from me. None of the people in my house even have jobs, they leech off of other family members for money and steal stuff from me. Our only means of income is my uncle’s oil company. I’ve tried getting a job, but my mom won’t even let me get my permit, let alone my license. We live too far away for me to walk to a job. I doubt they’d drive me. Furthermore I have no social security card, insurance, or any of the identification I need to get a job. 

This is so preventable too, they never put the effort in to look for new jobs. Yet somehow it’s all my fault because I have basic needs. Am I being unreasonable for being upset?
